Continuity of counsel
The partner who advises you at the consultation appears in your matter. Associates assist; they do not quietly replace.
Monday – Friday: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM
About Us
Established in 1997, we advise individuals, families and businesses across twelve areas of law — and we are as direct about what we cannot do as about what we can.
Who We Are
Singla & Singla Law Firm is a premier full-service legal practice based in Delhi-NCR delivering trusted advocacy since 1997. Built on over two decades of legal excellence, our firm provides strategic representation across Criminal, Civil, Matrimonial law and other legal matters.
We combine deep courtroom expertise with a nuanced, client-first approach to protect rights and resolve complex disputes effectively. From defending intricate criminal matters to navigating sensitive family dynamics and commercial conflicts, our team is committed to upholding justice with unwavering integrity. At Singla & Singla, we offer clear, results-driven solutions designed to safeguard our clients' interests at every stage of litigation.
Trusted experience. Professional counsel. Dedicated representation.
Our mission is to provide accessible, ethical, and result-oriented legal services while upholding the highest standards of integrity, professionalism, and client trust. We are committed to protecting our clients’ rights and delivering effective legal solutions with dedication and diligence.
To be the practice that regional families and businesses turn to first, trusted less for the cases we win than for the advice we give before a case exists.
Our History
The practice opened in 1997 with enrolment at the Bar Council, and its first years were spent at Tis Hazari Courts — two under a senior advocate, then in an independent chamber taking criminal, matrimonial, civil and MCD panel work. It grew by referral rather than advertising, adding a chamber at Karkardooma in 2009, a presence across Delhi's district courts through the years that followed, and a Delhi High Court practice from 2015.
Nearly three decades on, the firm advises across twelve disciplines from three chambers in East Delhi — Karkardooma Court, Trilokpuri and Mayur Vihar Phase 1 — with eight partners and associates and a support team that manages compliance calendars, filings and hearing schedules. The scale has changed; the operating principle has not.
Milestones
Nearly three decades of deliberate expansion — from a single chamber at Tis Hazari to representation across Delhi's district courts and the High Court.
1997
Enrolment & Entry into the Legal Profession
The journey began in 1997, with enrolment as an advocate with the Bar Council. With determination and a commitment to the profession, the foundation of a lifelong journey in law was laid.
1997–1999
Tis Hazari Courts
The initial two years were spent working under a senior advocate at Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi, gaining valuable courtroom experience and developing a strong foundation in litigation and advocacy.
1999–2000
Chamber at Tis Hazari
After gaining experience under senior guidance, an independent chamber was established at Tis Hazari Courts in association with professional colleagues.
During this phase, the practice also began handling matters connected with the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) through the MCD panel.
2000–2009

2009–2010
A New Chapter
The next major milestone came with the allotment of a chamber at Karkardooma Courts.
This marked the beginning of a wider practice extending beyond a single court complex and into different districts of Delhi.
2010–2015
Growing Reach, Growing Practice
The practice expanded across Delhi’s major district courts — Karkardooma, Patiala House, Dwarka, Rohini, Rouse Avenue and Tis Hazari.
With an expanding team of associates, the scope of legal practice also broadened to include:
2015–2020
Taking the Practice to the High Court
With years of experience in trial-court litigation, the practice expanded into the Delhi High Court, increasingly focusing on matters involving:
2020–Present
Singla & Singla Law Firm
What began as one advocate’s professional journey gradually evolved into a structured legal practice supported by a dedicated team of associates and professionals.
Today, Singla & Singla Law Firm provides legal assistance, litigation services and legal consultancy across a broad range of matters, with representation before Delhi’s District Courts and the Delhi High Court.
2026
Experience. Integrity. Commitment.
After nearly three decades of legal practice, the journey continues with the same commitment with which it began in 1997 — to provide dedicated legal representation, practical legal advice and professional assistance to every client.
Core Values
Six operating commitments that shape how every matter in this office is run.
An engagement letter setting out the fee basis precedes any work, with government charges itemised separately from professional fees.
You receive a short written note after each listed date explaining what happened and what comes next — not a phone call you have to chase.
We tell clients when a case is weak, when the timeline makes litigation uneconomic, and when settling is the better commercial answer.
A dispute touching tax, banking and corporate exposure is handled by the relevant partners together, not routed around the gaps.
Execution and recovery are part of the mandate. A decree that is never enforced is not a result, and we do not treat it as one.
Naveen Singla
Founder
